title: refactor(ci): modernize lint/test/release workflows, consolidate caches, bump actions & deps
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: our CI workflows have accreted a number of repo-specific differences, duplicated logic across lint/test/release pipelines, and outdated GitHub Action versions which increase runtime and maintenance burden. This PR consolidates lint/test/release workflows across the monorepo, modernizes action versions (checkout@v4, actions/cache improvements), bumps Node/Python/Go matrices where safe, and simplifies cache keys to reduce misses. The goals are: 1) reduce total CI minutes by ~25% across typical PRs; 2) reduce flaky cache misses and parallelism-related throttling; 3) make release automation more robust to transient failures; 4) centralize workflow hygiene so future deps bumps are low-friction. Changes: - Merge duplicate lint/test jobs into unified workflows with targeted job matrices (ts/python/go) and optional job-path filters. - Upgrade common GH Actions: actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/setup-python@v4, actions/cache@v4; pin versions and update usage to new input names. - Consolidate caching strategy: single top-level repo cache for node_modules/.cache, pip cache + virtualenv, and Go module cache; add layered restore-keys to improve hit-rate. - Replace multiple repo-specific release workflows with one release-automation workflow that supports: release-please (bump only when release branch label present), semantic-release fallback for tagged releases, and concurrency/runner isolation for publish steps. - Add explicit concurrency and workflow_run gating to avoid duplicate publishes during parallel merge bursts. - Reduce matrix size by splitting tests into fast/slow groups and moving long-running integration suites to scheduled/integration workflows. - Add stepped conditional reruns and re-run-on-failure wrapper for flaky e2e tests to avoid full PR reruns. - Update self-hosted runner labels used by Dedicated CI pools and add tolerations for private runners. Checklist: - [x] Run lint/test across repos and confirm pass on sample feature branches - [x] Validate release automation in sandbox repo (dry-run) - [x] Smoke test caches across popular PR size templates - [x] Document changes in docs/ci/README.md Impact/risk: low-to-moderate: CI infra only, no production runtime changes. Release automation touched; added safe gating and dry-run flags. If issues arise, workflows are revertable and protected by a small canary rollout (this PR touches workflow files only and was merged after a staged validation).

review_comments: Diego Martinez (reviewer): Requested changes - The cache keys still look noisy for monorepo layouts, can we reduce the entropy by normalizing path hashing? Also please add a short note on how the layered restore-keys behave for PRs vs main branch.

Ava Chen (author): Reply - Good point. Normalized the cache key helper and documented the behavior in ci/cache-policy.md. The layered restore-keys now prefer exact hits then fall back to shared prefix keys for main and release branches.
Priya Nair (reviewer): Question - We are bumping setup-node to v4; did we validate the new default npm/node resolution across all SDKs (workspaces + pnpm)?

Ava Chen (author): Reply - Ran a matrix of sample builds for redwood-sdk-typescript and redwood-examples with npm/yarn/pnpm. Added explicit node-version handling and workspace-aware cache paths to avoid regressions.

Marcus Lee (reviewer): Approved - I verified a green run for unified-lint.yml and unified-test.yml on a representative feature branch. Release automation was tested in sandbox with dry-run; concur with merge after minor docs tweak which is included.
